propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency correctness criterion; four production races in the repo demonstrate the gap between security/performance overlays and base reviewer capabilities.

A deterministic two-layer lexical trigger (high-precision committed token list + project-extensible noisy tier in criteria_routing.json) fires the concurrency overlay based on diff content to detect inconsistent synchronization on shared resources.

The concurrency overlay operates as a Pass-1 specialist advisory overlay (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) using lockset-first heuristics to decompose into reachability and absence claims verifiable by existing Pass-2 disciplines.
Built-in overlays must be extensible; projects can override trigger vocabulary and applies_to globs through criteria_routing.json without code changes.
The concurrency overlay ships with documented blind spots (no-twin races, CI-level CAS judgment) and rebar dogfoods its own noisy-tier trigger configuration as the worked example.
